title: Add Support for EIP-7939 (CLZ Opcode) in the FEVM
description: This proposal adds the CLZ (Count Leading Zeros) opcode to the Filecoin EVM (FEVM), matching Ethereum’s EIP-7939 behavior. CLZ provides a fast, gas-efficient way to count leading zero bits in a 256-bit word, which is widely used in math, compression, bitmap, and ZK proving workflows.

applicationDevelopers: Improves developer experience and compatibility with Ethereum environments that include EIP-7939.
Enables more efficient on-chain implementations for math primitives, compression/decompression, and bitmap navigation.
Can reduce ZK proving costs for applications that currently emulate CLZ using SHR.
